def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation

    for n in seg['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); r1=max(p[0] for p in bb)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bb); c1=max(p[1] for p in bb)
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and r0<50: pt=(r0,r1)

        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']>=8:
            bb=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); r1=max(p[0] for p in bb)
            tg[n['color']]=(r0,r1)
    return pt,tip,tg
